root_cause.text: The restart logic to retry a bucket when the saved "last" helper is deleted was placed after the for loop, so when the loop completes with cb->args[0] equal to the hash table size, the "goto restart" jumps back into the loop body past the bounds check, causing an out-of-bounds read on nf_ct_helper_hash[nf_ct_helper_hsize].
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `if (cb->args[1])` block (which contains `goto restart`) from after the for loop into the loop body, as described in the commit message: "the 'goto restart' block was meant to re-traverse the current bucket when 'last' is no longer found, but it was placed after the for loop instead of inside it." The commit also notes that the loop finishes with cb->args[0] == nf_ct_helper_hsize, and jumping back bypasses the bounds check.

intent_record.intent_summary: Move restart check inside loop to fix netlink dump restart logic for conntrack helper.
intent_record.what: Moved the `if (cb->args[1])` block from outside the closing brace of a block to inside it, so the restart condition and goto are now part of the same block (likely a loop body).
intent_record.how: The check for cb->args[1] and the subsequent goto restart are now executed during each iteration of the loop instead of after the loop completes. This ensures that a restart occurs immediately when needed, rather than after the loop finishes.
